description:
The company dossier: the full unmasked record, the misconduct check (CNIA) done live and the risk traffic light. Paid per company.
It costs the fixed dollar price per company (`PRECO_DOSSIE_USD`, in `/api/pricing`; without it, the real amount of `PRECO_DOSSIE_BRL` at the Pix exchange rate): it is charged to the prepaid credit (`Authorization: Bearer cred_…` or `X-Credito`), or you pay only this dossier with x402 (`X-PAYMENT`). It brings everything that `GET /api/cnpj/:cnpj` brings, with full partners, phones and e-mail, the CNIA checked live and `semaforo`: `cor` (`vermelho`, `amarelo` or `verde`), `alertas` and `atencao` (each one `{ id, n?, valor?, saldo?, situacao? }`) and `sem_conferencia` (the blocks that did not answer now; the color does not turn green for lack of data). The same credit code asking for the same company on the same day (Brasília time) does not pay again. A nonexistent CNPJ or a failed lookup charges nothing. The answer is not cached.

cnpj.description: CNPJ without punctuation: 14 digits or the alphanumeric one (12 letters or digits and 2 check digits), such as 12ABC34501DE35.
